name: openworld
description: Open-world multiplayer game set in real Indian places, starting with FCI Colony, Kakinada

scripts.build:world: python3 tools/build_world.py --osm data/raw/fci_colony_1km.osm --lat 17.0143794 --lon 82.2647444 --radius 1000 --name "FCI Colony, Vakalapudi, Kakinada" --notes data/survey/owner_notes_2026-10-30.json --google-buildings data/raw/buildings/google_fci_area.csv --out data/world/fci_colony.json
scripts.build: mkdir -p data/world viewer/dist && npm run build:world && npm run build:viewer
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:data && npm run test:e2e
